vision.title: What DIASPORA.GA is
vision.lead: The closed social network of Gabonese people living abroad: your country, your community, and you always know who is posting.

country.title: Your country, your community
country.body: The feed and news of your country of residence, once it is open, and what matters to the whole diaspora.

people.title: Find Gabonese people of the diaspora
people.body: Search for a member by name or username. The directory is opt-in: you only appear in it if you chose to.

pages.title: Associations, businesses, institutions
pages.body: Their pages, what they post in their own name, and joining an association.

groupsAndEvents.title: Groups and events
groupsAndEvents.body: Groups for an association's members, and its events on the calendar.

services.title: The diaspora's services
services.body: Services offered by the network's pages, from the request to the appointment.

jobs.title: Jobs and talent
jobs.body: Job offers, and talents visible by choice.

mutualAid.title: Help each other
mutualAid.body: Practical questions between members, and volunteer missions.

mentoring.title: Mentoring
mentoring.body: Volunteer mentors you can ask for advice.

arrivalKit.title: Settle in
arrivalKit.body: An arrival kit with dated resources, to settle in your country of residence.

contact.title: Talk without exposing your contact details
contact.body: Contact goes through messaging: a “Write” button, never a displayed phone number.

closed.title: Reserved for Gabonese people abroad
closed.body: What is posted here stays here, unless its author chooses to share it on ANTSIA.

speaker.title: You always know who is speaking
speaker.body: Every account and every page carries a trust marker computed by the network, never self-declared.

verified.title: Verified with your consent
verified.body: consulat.ga confirms a consular registration and nothing else: no passport, no civil records, no file.

verifiedSoon.title: Soon: verified with your consent
verifiedSoon.body: Verification through the IDN digital identity and through consulat.ga is on its way. consulat.ga will confirm a consular registration and nothing else: no passport, no civil records, no file.

sponsored.title: Or sponsored
sponsored.body: A verified member who knows you can sponsor you; every sponsorship is recorded.

data.title: Your data, your choices
data.body: Separate, revocable consents, an opt-in directory, export and erasure from your settings.

free.title: Free for members
free.body: Access to the network is free; a professional service may have its own price.

steps.account: Create your account with a code received by email, no password.
steps.residence: Tell us where you live: your country of residence, then your consents, one by one.
steps.publish: Read right away; post after the consular verification or a sponsorship.
steps.publishSponsored: Read right away; post as soon as a verified member sponsors you.
